description: Select a permitted text-chat model or reasoning effort for the current run. Premium selection requires exact human approval; later runs retain their normal assignments.

levels.conservative: MODEL-SWITCHING POSTURE — Conservative: stay on your default model at its default effort. Only switch model, or raise reasoning effort, when the user explicitly asks or when you are genuinely stuck and a stronger model / deeper thinking is the clear remedy. Do not proactively upgrade or raise effort.
levels.eager: MODEL-SWITCHING POSTURE — Eager: choose an eligible text-chat model and supported reasoning effort appropriate to the task. Premium changes require exact human approval. Use Image Vision/Image Generation for assigned Image In/Out roles. No closing revert is needed at run end.

guidance.no_premium_model: No premium model is configured, so there's nothing stronger to upgrade onto. Tell the user plainly that an admin can assign the Premium role to a capable model in App Config → Models. Do NOT pretend you switched.

settings.label: Model switching
settings.hint: Prompt posture for current-run text-chat model and effort selection. Image work uses assigned Image In/Out roles. Later runs keep normal defaults.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
